name: Summon Electronics INC
old_description: Part Genie solves complex sourcing fast - with traceability, margin logic, and shelf-ready packs baked in.
about:
Summon Electronics operates from Longwood, Florida, where it began as an open-market sourcing partner for contract manufacturers and OEMs. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available materials.

The firm specializes in procuring hard-to-find and obsolete electronic components — semiconductors, ICs, FPGAs, microcontrollers, passives, connectors, relays, power supplies, and MRO items — while maintaining inventory programs that include blanket and scheduled orders. It also provides instant PCB assembly quotes via BOM upload, PPAP support with traceability documentation, engineering assistance, in-house cable assembly and reeling, and ESD/MSL-compliant packaging.

Its customer base spans OEM buyers, contract manufacturers, transit authorities, specialty lighting manufacturers, temperature-component vendors, and generator assembly contractors. Case studies cite a discontinued part delivered in three days, a rebuilt supply chain for a transit authority, custom LED strips for a retro pinball project, and verified precision resistors for thermal sensor designs.

Summon positions itself as a frontline partner rather than a traditional distributor, emphasizing real-time human support, kanban systems to keep production moving, and a sourcing engine (branded Part Genie) that returns traceability paperwork, margin compliance, and shelf-pack strategies alongside pricing.
